notes: IMPORTANT: This document is a peer-reviewed medical journal article (The Lancet Regional Health - Europe, 2021) reporting the UK Lung Cancer Screening (UKLS) randomised controlled trial and an international meta-analysis of 9 RCTs, NOT a Finnish public health report. Consequently, there are no values for Finland, Finnish wellbeing services counties (hyvinvointialueet), collaborative areas (yhteistyöalueet), waiting times/days to treatment, or Finnish survival/treatment shares; area_id is null for all extracted items. UKLS recruited 4055 participants aged 50-75 with LLPv2 5-year risk >=4.5% (2011-2013), with 3968 in the intention-to-treat analysis (1987 LDCT single-screen arm, 1981 usual care control arm), followed to 31 Dec 2019 for incidence (median 7.2 years) and 29 Feb 2020 for mortality (median 7.3 years). Per instructions, stage breakdowns (Table 2), histological cell type breakdowns (Table 3), and single-year numbers-at-risk time series in cumulative Kaplan-Meier/Nelson-Aalen plots (Figs 2-6, pages 23-28) were omitted because higher-level incidence, mortality, surgical suitability, and meta-analysis indicators were reported. UK targeted screening implementation participation rates were reported only as a range (40-53%) and omitted as non-scalar.
